title: Myntasha
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Heroes of the Realm characters)

paragraphs.text: Myntasha , Honored One , is a legendary snow elk from an unknown plane.

The character of Myntasha was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2019 Heroes of the Realm program. It appears to be a large elk with white fur that glows green with some form of energy or mana . It can generate a glowing ball of it between its large horns and has waves of it connecting to or coming off of it from its surroundings.
